arg.activate: Request adding and selecting LMM; this does not mean it has been applied
arg.add_only: Add LMM without changing the current selection
arg.all: Include only installed, supported targets; updates also require management approval
arg.dry_run: Create a plan without applying changes
arg.fix: Request approved LMM repairs without bypassing capability checks
arg.instance: Explicit local instance root; remote and Docker instances are not scanned
arg.issuer: Trusted LMM HTTPS origin; set explicitly for a self-hosted server
arg.json: Write JSON without CLI prompts or configuration contents
arg.lang: Display language: en or zh-CN; overrides LMM_LANG and locale variables
arg.no_browser: Print the login URL; the browser must still reach this machine through loopback
arg.non_interactive: Do not wait for input when a target or authorization is missing
arg.query: Search text; omit to list all entries
arg.report: Create a shareable report without paths or configuration contents
arg.software: Exact catalog ID, such as astrbot or cc-switch
arg.timeout: Maximum wait for the browser callback, in seconds
arg.yes: Approve the displayed scope, not account changes, provider switches, or paid tests
auth.already_logged_in: The CLI is already signed in; run lmm logout before switching accounts. Application grants will not be transferred
auth.busy: Another LMM authorization operation is running, or a secure per-user lock could not be created
auth.callback: Could not bind the local OAuth callback port
auth.credential_store: Could not access the system vault. Unlock Keychain, Credential Manager, or Secret Service; plain-text files will not be used
auth.invalid_issuer: issuer must be a canonical HTTPS domain origin without a port, path, query, or credentials
auth.invalid_response: The LMM OAuth response was invalid; authorization has stopped
auth.network: The LMM network request failed; check connectivity and whether the server has enabled the lmm client
auth.not_logged_in: Not signed in; run lmm login first
auth.output: Could not display the login URL; login has stopped
auth.refresh_blocked: The previous refresh did not complete reliably. The old refresh token will not be reused; run logout, then login
auth.timeout: Login timed out; no further requests were sent
auth.unauthorized: The server rejected authorization; sign in again or check that the lmm client is deployed
auth.unstored_grant: The new grant could not be saved and revocation could not be confirmed; check LMM CLI on the LMM authorization page
callback.invalid: Invalid or denied authorization. Return to LMM CLI.
callback.received: Authorization received. Return to LMM CLI to check completion.
cli.about: LMM: provider presets, software discovery, and read-only OAuth (development preview)
cmd.catalog: Search the software catalog; entries are not verified integrations
cmd.disconnect: Plan removal of an integration and its application grant
cmd.doctor: Run read-only checks; --fix still requires adapter support and approval
cmd.install: Plan software installation; LMM login is not required
cmd.login: Sign in with a browser and store credentials in the system vault
cmd.logout: Sign out of the CLI without revoking other application grants
cmd.models: Read authorized models and prices without calling or selecting a model
cmd.presets: Search the built-in provider snapshot without reading credentials or using the network
cmd.restore: Plan field-level restoration while preserving later user edits
cmd.run: Request a launch with the selected software configuration
cmd.setup: Preview setup; writes stay blocked until a verified adapter is available
cmd.status: Inspect local environment and path evidence without making changes
cmd.sync: Plan an LMM refresh while preserving the current provider and model
cmd.uninstall: Plan removal of managed software; keep user data by default
cmd.update: Plan updates for software explicitly placed under management
error.auth_unattended: The system vault may need to be unlocked; OAuth commands do not support --non-interactive yet. No credentials or network were accessed
error.catalog_output: Could not write the software catalog
error.config_shape: not a bounded regular configuration file
error.instance_unsupported: Instance selection is not supported for this software; --instance will not be ignored
error.invalid_instance: --instance must be an absolute local path for this environment; remote and container adapters are not available
error.login_interactive: Login needs browser approval; run lmm login in an interactive terminal. Unattended mode will not wait or consent for you
error.login_output: Could not write the login result
error.logout_output: Could not write the logout result
error.menu_output: Could not display the selection menu
error.no_selection: No target selected; no changes were made
error.presets_read: Could not read the built-in provider presets
error.target_required: Unattended mode requires a software ID or --all; no changes were made
error.unknown_software: Unknown software ID; run lmm catalog to find the exact name
error.unsupported_language: Unsupported language. Use en or zh-CN.
note.all_blocked: No automatic integration adapter has been verified; --all has no executable targets. No software was installed or changed
note.doctor_incomplete: Diagnosis is incomplete: only local path evidence was checked. Check the selected instance, version, and configuration manager. No network or paid tests were run
note.dry_run: Plan only; blockers remain unresolved. This is not evidence of a completed integration
note.execution_blocked: No safe execution adapter is available for this target; no software was started or removed, no configuration changed, and no grants revoked
note.fix_blocked: No repair adapter has been verified; configuration was not changed
note.install: Installation does not require LMM login; a verified installation adapter is not available yet
note.yes: --yes does not bypass missing capabilities, authorization, or cost limits
output.authorization_url:
Approve LMM CLI in your browser (catalog and balance reads only; no application migration):
{url}
output.blocked_plan: {software} plan blocked: no configuration changes, paid calls, or restarts
output.browser_failed: The browser could not be opened. Open the URL above in a browser on this machine.
output.login: LMM CLI is signed in. Credentials are stored in the system vault. Applications have not been granted model-call permission; run lmm models to read the catalog.
output.logout: CLI signed out. Other application grants were not revoked and cannot be listed by this version.
output.models: Authorized models (application compatibility is not verified; final costs depend on usage):
output.presets: Built-in provider presets (Magpie snapshot {revision}); configuration and connectivity were not checked. No providers were added.
output.scope: Scope: current user and runtime environment; checked at {time} (Unix seconds)
output.target: {software}: installation cannot be confirmed; installation and configuration managers are unknown
output.verification: LMM added/active: unknown; authorization, connectivity, application, streaming, and tool calls: not checked
plan.application_grant: CLI login allows only catalog and balance reads; separate application authorization is not connected yet
plan.install_adapter: A verified software version, download-source check, and installation adapter are required
plan.paid_verification: Paid verification requires explicit consent, a known quote, and a server-enforced spending limit
plan.restore_adapter: No target change journal or native transaction adapter is connected; backups cannot be overwritten directly
plan.revoked_grant: The application grant was revoked; explicit approval is required to authorize it again
plan.unknown_selection: The current provider is unknown; first read the selected instance configuration
plan.unverified_target: The software version, configuration manager, and actual request path have not been verified
plan.write_adapter: This version has no verified configuration-write adapter for the target software
purpose.astrbot: Agent and bot runtime for messaging platforms
purpose.cc_switch: Provider configuration management and local routing
purpose.pi: Terminal agent; its LMM provider is a separate project
restore.conflict: The field changed after LMM wrote it; restoration has stopped
restore.duplicate_field: The change journal contains duplicate fields
restore.invalid_pointer: Could not locate the parent object for the field to restore
restore.unsupported_shape: Only individual scalar fields in objects are supported; collections need a dedicated adapter

select.title: Select software to plan setup (no integration has been verified yet):
